# oriz Image Studio

> Free, 100% in-browser image toolkit — resize, crop, compress, convert (PNG/JPG/WebP), strip EXIF metadata, and generate AI alt-text. No upload, no signup, nothing stored. Every pixel stays on your device.

Live app: https://img.oriz.in

## Tools

- [Resize & convert](https://img.oriz.in): Set exact width/height with aspect lock, export to WebP, JPEG or PNG.
- [Compress](https://img.oriz.in): Dial quality to shrink file size for the web while keeping images sharp.
- [Crop](https://img.oriz.in): Crop images in-browser before export.
- [Strip EXIF metadata](https://img.oriz.in): Canvas re-encode drops orientation, GPS and camera data automatically.
- [AI alt-text](https://img.oriz.in): Generate accessible alt-text for any image using free in-browser AI, no key required.

## About

- [Info page](https://chirag127.github.io/oriz-img/): What oriz Image Studio is, features, tech.
- [Source](https://github.com/chirag127/oriz-img): MIT-licensed source repo.
- [Full content](https://img.oriz.in/llms-full.txt): Full site text as markdown for LLM ingestion.
